Job Summary

Manage and oversee the consolidation, validation, analysis, and reporting of project cost and forecast information projects to ensure financial performance is accurately monitored, forecasted, and aligned with corporate objectives. Provide governance, analytical insights, and cost control recommendations that support project management, operational decision-making, and business performance.

Key
Metric

Pellet Mill Operator

Location: Singkawang, West Kalimantan
Company: PT Japfa Comfeed Indonesia Tbk

Job Description

Key Responsibilities

Production & Pelleting Operations

• Set pellet mill rolls according to feed formulations and production requirements to achieve optimal machine performance and production capacity.
• Adjust crumbler rolls based on feed type to ensure the required particle size specifications are met.
• Operate pellet mill machines efficiently to maximize production output and machine performance.
• Replace dies, rolls, and sieves according to maintenance schedules and operational requirements.
• Separate start-up and shutdown production batches to maintain consistent feed color and product quality.
• Perform proper changeover inspections and procedures to prevent cross-contamination between different feed products.

Quality Control

• Conduct routine particle size inspections to ensure compliance with quality standards.
• Monitor and verify Pellet Durability Index (PDI) according to company specifications to ensure pellet strength during storage and transportation.
• Ensure feed conditioning temperature meets the required standards to support feed quality and bacterial control.
• Monitor feed temperature after the cooler to ensure products meet specifications before packaging.
• Maintain product quality through proper machine cleanliness and operational controls.
• Inspect bins during product changes to prevent contamination and maintain feed quality standards.

Equipment Maintenance

• Clean magnet pipes, elevators, and pellet press equipment to prevent metal contamination and ensure smooth material flow.
• Monitor motor and bearing temperatures regularly to prevent overheating and equipment failure.
• Apply lubrication or oil to dies at the end of each shift to prevent blockages and maintain equipment performance.
• Perform autonomous maintenance activities on pellet mill machines and supporting equipment.
• Maintain the cleanliness of internal machine components to ensure optimal machine performance and product quality.

Reporting & Documentation

• Prepare pellet mill downtime reports for performance analysis and continuous improvement initiatives.
• Prepare daily pelleting efficiency reports, including machine performance and production capacity data.
• Maintain autonomous maintenance records for pellet mill equipment.
• Accurately record and report machine operating conditions and production performance.

Housekeeping, Safety & Compliance

• Maintain cleanliness of machines, equipment, and work areas in accordance with company housekeeping standards.
• Ensure work areas remain safe, organized, and conducive to operational efficiency.
• Comply with Occupational Health and Safety (OHS) requirements, including proper use of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE).
• Report unsafe conditions, equipment malfunctions, and product quality deviations to the supervisor.
• Follow all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), work instructions, and company policies.

Pellet Mill Operator

Lokasi: Singkawang, Kalimantan Barat
Perusahaan: PT Japfa Comfeed Indonesia Tbk

Deskripsi Pekerjaan (Job Description)

Tanggung Jawab Utama

Operasional Pelleting dan Produksi

• Melakukan pengaturan (setting) roll mesin pellet press sesuai formula dan kondisi produksi untuk mencapai kapasitas dan kualitas yang ditetapkan.
• Melakukan pengaturan (setting) roll mesin crumbler sesuai jenis produk pakan guna menghasilkan ukuran partikel yang sesuai standar.
• Mengoperasikan mesin pellet press secara optimal untuk memaksimalkan kapasitas dan efisiensi produksi.
• Melakukan penggantian die, roll, dan saringan (sieve) sesuai jadwal maupun kebutuhan operasional.
• Melaksanakan pemisahan produk awal dan akhir produksi (start-up dan shut-down product segregation) untuk menjaga konsistensi warna dan kualitas produk.
• Memastikan proses pergantian produksi (change over) dilakukan dengan baik untuk mencegah kontaminasi silang antar produk.

Pengendalian Mutu Produk

• Melakukan pemeriksaan ukuran partikel (particle size) pakan secara berkala untuk memastikan kesesuaian dengan standar mutu.
• Melakukan pemeriksaan Pellet Durability Index (PDI) sesuai standar perusahaan untuk memastikan kekuatan fisik pellet selama penyimpanan dan distribusi.
• Memastikan suhu conditioning mash mencapai standar yang ditentukan guna mendukung proses pemasakan dan pengendalian bakteri.
• Melakukan pengecekan suhu pakan setelah cooler untuk memastikan produk aman dan sesuai standar sebelum dikemas.
• Memastikan kualitas pakan tetap terjaga melalui kebersihan mesin dan area proses produksi.
• Melakukan pemeriksaan bin saat pergantian produk untuk mencegah terjadinya kontaminasi.

Pemeliharaan dan Perawatan Peralatan

• Membersihkan pipe magnet, elevator, dan mesin press untuk mencegah kontaminasi logam serta menjaga kelancaran aliran material.
• Melakukan pengecekan suhu motor dan bearing secara rutin untuk mencegah overheating dan kerusakan peralatan.
• Memberikan pelumas atau minyak pada die sesuai prosedur pada akhir shift untuk menjaga kondisi peralatan dan mencegah penyumbatan.
• Melakukan perawatan mandiri (autonomous maintenance) terhadap mesin pellet mill dan peralatan pendukung.
• Menjaga kebersihan bagian dalam mesin guna mendukung performa mesin dan kualitas produk.

Pelaporan dan Dokumentasi

• Membuat laporan downtime mesin pellet press untuk kebutuhan analisis dan perbaikan berkelanjutan.
• Menyusun laporan harian efisiensi proses pelleting, termasuk kapasitas produksi dan performa mesin.
• Menyusun laporan kegiatan perawatan mandiri mesin pellet press.
• Melakukan pencatatan dan pelaporan kondisi operasional mesin secara akurat dan tepat waktu.

Housekeeping, K3, dan Kepatuhan

• Menjaga kebersihan mesin, peralatan, dan area kerja sesuai standar housekeeping perusahaan.
• Memastikan area kerja selalu dalam kondisi aman, rapi, dan mendukung operasional yang efektif.
• Menerapkan standar Keselamatan dan Kesehatan Kerja (K3), penggunaan APD, serta prosedur kerja yang berlaku.
• Melaporkan setiap kondisi tidak aman, kerusakan peralatan, atau penyimpangan kualitas kepada atasan.
• Mematuhi seluruh SOP, instruksi kerja, dan kebijakan perusahaan dalam menjalankan tugas.

Founded in 1966, Kalbe Farma (Kalbe) is the largest publicly-listed pharmaceutical company in Southeast Asia. As of end 2023, Kalbe’s extensive healthcare ecosystem encompasses a network of 47 companies, including subsidiaries, joint ventures, and associates, all driven by a dedicated workforce of 16,795 employees.

Guided by a vision to become the country’s best global healthcare company, Kalbe offers a comprehensive healthcare solution through its four key business divisions: prescription pharmaceuticals, consumer health, nutrition, and distribution & logistics. Within these divisions, Kalbe manages a diverse portfolio reinforced by a robust distribution network that serves over one million outlets across Indonesia’s vast archipelago.

On the international stage, Kalbe has established a strong presence in ASEAN countries, as well as regions spanning East and South Asia, the Middle East, and Africa. Kalbe’s business ventures are supported by best in- class research and development capabilities, developed through strategic alliances with many international partners. The Company is deeply involved in cutting-edge areas such as drug delivery systems, cancer treatment, stem cell research, and biotechnology.
